name: tepegoz-browser
description: Agentic automation browser — observable, security-by-design, local-first (cloud-optional). Windows 11 primary.
author: Kuray Karaaslan <kuraykaraaslan@gmail.com>

scripts.eval: turbo run build --filter=@tepegoz/desktop && playwright test --config playwright.eval.config.ts

//devDependencies: `@tepegoz/i18n` is a devDependency of the ROOT so the Playwright suite can import the real `IME_MATRIX` instead of keeping a second copy of it. A runner that carries its own cases stops testing the matrix the moment the matrix changes. `@tepegoz/chat-adapters` + `@tepegoz/chat-transport-node` are ROOT devDependencies for the same reason: a live chat e2e spec needs a real, second XMPP client (bob) driven from Node directly, not through the app under test — that requires the actual adapter, not a hand-rolled protocol stub.
